probe_policy.declared_scope: Every direct PDF and MP3 in the official 2012 and 2018 JLPT Official Practice Workbook sections. This is a sample-workbook scope, not an archive of every administered JLPT sitting.

retained_local_state.unreferenced_evidence: The unreferenced half is the older per-level storage-key identity set; it is preserved pending a reviewed deduplication decision.

legal_and_technical.restriction: The official policy limits use and requires separate authorization for third-party works in N1/N2 grammar/reading and all N1-N5 listening audio. No blanket archive-republication grant was established.
legal_and_technical.robots_status: The current robots policy names some automated agents and imposes a crawl delay on one bot; no access control was bypassed.

publication_risk.manifest_agreement_warning: Exact source/local URL agreement proves only the declared workbook denominator; it does not authorize redistribution or imply historical sitting coverage.
